Fixes: Fix blank Wayland screenshares when missing or stale session metadata sends Discord to its X11 capturer. The launcher passes the correct session type when Electron uses Wayland.
Improvements: Update the AUR package description to reflect Linux support and quality-of-life improvements.
Accelerate large application, Electron, and Discord module downloads with up to eight connections selected from the measured transfer rate. Split downloads can be turned off in General settings.
Open cached installations before checking for network updates, fetch the pinned Electron directly on first launch, and prepare Electron and Discord modules in parallel when possible.
Speed up Discord voice setup by reusing decoded ELF data and counting changes only within reviewed patch ranges.
Fixes: Retry interrupted download ranges and verify the complete checksum before accepting a file. Fall back to one connection when range responses are unusable.
Verify native patch output on disk and check each patch stage against the previous stage before replacing the voice module.

Improvements: Show the HTML updater splash from a verified cached Electron before downloading a replacement application, then switch to the prepared runtime automatically.
Fixes: Show recoverable startup and installation errors in the Electron splash. Reserve native error dialogs for failures that prevent Electron from displaying that splash.
Keep first-run launch flag discard confirmations inside the DPE Settings window.

Improvements: Update Discord Canary to 1.0.2513 and port Electron 46.0.0-alpha.13, preserving upstream security fixes and the new native voice-module layout.
Fixes: Allow Direct screensharing permission setup on Fedora Atomic systems with a root-owned /usr/local symlink and read-only /usr. Store the polkit action under /etc and validate symlink targets and ancestors before trusting privileged helpers.
Label the Optimized screensharing and application-audio picker action “Stream”.
Recover application-audio capture after Discord’s native PulseAudio connection fails, preserving the selected app and retrying the recorder without restarting the video share.
Wait for the private PipeWire audio bridge to be ready before attaching native capture, and preserve accepted shares when late picker cancellation callbacks arrive.
Report audio-helper failures and exhausted recorder retries with bounded diagnostics instead of leaving application audio silently unavailable.

Improvements: Make bun dev run current automatically select a cache for the current Git branch and working tree, refresh changed UI/helpers, and reassemble changed native support or packaging inputs using a matching verified Electron runtime. Existing development profiles are preserved.

Use a same-graph PipeWire loopback for application-audio capture instead of the raw pw-cat-to-pacat bridge, avoiding an extra PCM FIFO while keeping capture bound to the selected private sinks. Real PulseAudio retains its separate bridge.
Fixes: Match Niri PiP top spacing to configured gaps and struts without adding the previous 16-pixel minimum at the top; preserve side and bottom margins and corner highlighting.
Return an unavailable PiP state when a pending compositor query finishes after the window closes, avoiding access to a destroyed window.
Restart managed development windows when a relaunch signal arrives while the old process is still running.

New: Choose the default PiP corner, turn automatic positioning on or off, and control whether floating PiP windows stay on top.
Move a floating PiP window between corners directly from its corner controls.
Improvements: Respect compositor work areas, monitor scaling and reserved space when placing PiP windows on Niri, Sway, Hyprland and KDE Wayland. KDE placement uses temporary KWin scripts without changing window rules.
Group dependent PiP settings under their controlling options and share the select layout with Display settings.
Run managed development versions with temporary profiles, route Discord links to the selected running profile, and count shared files once when reporting disk usage.
Check AppImage builds and launches in the main checks workflow, share project setup across workflows, and declare KDE PiP integration dependencies in Linux packages.
Fixes: Size PiP windows from the current video rather than stale geometry, distinguish letterboxing from window chrome, and bound the initial window even when video metadata is unavailable.
Preserve manual PiP resizing and placement, restore normal geometry after fullscreen, and avoid treating compositor mapping events as user changes.
Hide both native and Discord titlebars on floating PiP windows, keep minimum-size changes in sync, and restore popout lifecycle behavior when closing or navigating.
Open ordinary web links in the system browser without replacing the Discord page, including links that navigate in the same window.
Resolve Discord protocol ownership from the actual desktop command and register the selected application or development profile reliably, including paths requiring desktop-entry escaping.
Recover interrupted source patch application on CI runners without a global Git identity and make capture descriptor-cleanup tests reliable when run in parallel.
Port the complete native binary patch chain to Canary 1.0.2483 and accept its sixth popout spellcheck callback argument.
Update the Electron alpha.10 audio/video dependency patch context while preserving the existing integration.
Port the FFmpeg build changes to Electron alpha.10 while preserving upstream aligned frame sizes, plane layouts and Media Foundation buffer lifetimes.
Improvements: Make downloading development runtime artifacts an explicit option.

Fixes: Complete the remaining Chromium dependency patch ports and source preflight for Electron alpha.10.

Improvements: Detect updates from both Discord's Electron fork and upstream Electron, including fork changes when the upstream version has not changed.
Allow a one-off Electron workflow run on the self-hosted PC while keeping budgeted Blacksmith builds as the default.
Automatically merge main into dev after main changes, preserving development commits and reporting merge conflicts for a maintainer to resolve.
Advance the tracked upstream Electron source to 46.0.0-alpha.10.
Package the completed, qualified Electron alpha.10 runtime from the local workflow build.

New: Add a separate Picture-in-picture button beside Discord’s normal call pop-out control. Normal pop-outs retain Discord’s behavior; PiP always requests compact floating, corner placement and topmost behavior.
Add monitor arrows below the PiP corner picker. Transfer the owned PiP between monitors without following focus; hide monitor navigation when no supported neighbor exists.
Improvements: Show non-video participants in PiP by default, independently of the regular call preference. Retain cameras, remote screenshares and activities, and use the native focused view for a sole visible tile.
Keep the corner picker available on empty PiP screens. Hide the PiP entry throughout Discord while PiP is active and use Discord’s interactive color tokens for its icon.
Link the PiP hidden-participants message directly to its settings section with an Open DPE Settings button.
Fixes: Apply participant visibility to Discord’s parent-rendered PiP portal instead of overriding a child-window store. Keep PiP-only checkbox changes separate from regular calls, exclude the current user’s share from automatic focus, and restore automatic layout changes when PiP closes.
Reclaim the layout slot of the empty invitation/activity card, recover missing corner controls, preserve native compositor resizing, and keep monitor moves inside each destination’s usable area.
Respect Niri’s configured gap and struts on each edge without a minimum inset, while retaining panel reservations and corner highlighting.
Assemble application archives with the pinned ASAR tool under Bun so a broken system Node shared-library dependency does not prevent development builds.
Keep Open DPE Settings on one line with the shared button padding and preserved native label markup. Open the normal independent Settings window directly at PiP settings instead of a child dialog.

Preserve PiP client size and relative position when switching monitors. Keep exact corners anchored, fit only when required by a smaller display, and restore the preferred size and placement on return.

Improvements: Add Picture-in-picture after the settings cog in Discord’s in-app video overlay, using its native icon colors, spacing and keyboard behavior. Keep the ordinary popout control and hide the extra entry while a separate PiP is active.

Fixes: Initialize PiP selection and fullscreen from the outer native call view, bypassing shared guild-room content only in explicit PiP. Retry when media arrives, select media even in an empty fullscreen layout, and preserve the media shown by an explicit in-app PiP click while excluding own screenshares.

Refresh call and in-app overlay PiP entries when native close completes after returning to Discord, including unchanged native PureComponents. Restore unchanged automatic selection on close and keep ordinary overlay popout clicks separate from unfinished PiP requests.

Improvements: Follow Discord’s in-app PiP corner by default while retaining the configured fallback corner for main-call launches. Summarize PiP controls and diagnostic ZIP export in the README.
Fixes: Hide the PiP non-video-participant menu control when its DPE preference is disabled, including protection against stale menu actions.
Minimize PiP members on launch and on video, screenshare or activity selection and layout changes. Preserve manual Show Members until the next transition and honor manual deselection of a sole tile.
Keep Discord’s native pop-in control visible in fullscreen PiP, using its regular whole-call close action for returning to Discord.

Improvements: Share control registration, immutable insertion, export replacement and lifecycle cleanup across call controls, the PiP corner/monitor mover, Settings entries, screenshare menu actions and audio picker hosts. Keep native Discord styling, callbacks and other extensions through rerenders and remounts.
Fixes: Show Return to Discord as soon as PiP opens, including before its window handle reaches Discord’s window store, and preserve the native return action through fullscreen and layout changes.
Support frozen native component exports without losing unrelated exports or another adapter’s replacement. Prevent duplicate injected controls and keep rebuilt menus on their current callbacks.
Cancel an open audio picker exactly once during page teardown, release its observer and ignore late PiP mover replies after cleanup.

Improvements: Update Discord Canary 1.0.2483 to the reviewed module revision 19.
Share verified module downloads between native checks and development builds, and remove disposable test runtimes and profiles after checks finish.
Fixes: Keep development archives locked while they are copied or extracted, and preserve archives currently in use when pruning the download cache.
Wait for actual popout destruction and persisted setup completion during release qualification, and handle display-clamped settings window sizes correctly.

Improvements: Update Discord Canary to 1.0.2484, preserving upstream audio retransmission and RTCP NACK sequence handling.
Fixes: Port the reviewed voice-module preparation and capture hooks to the new client while retaining app-audio recovery, video timing, scaling and software AV1 decoding fixes.
